/poll question: No More Artisan, Only Non-Com Builds! by Cairo + Carphira/Das Boots
text:
Author: Cairo + Carphira/Das Boots
Post: https://discord.com/channels/766364534495117383/1286801164326797385/1531785459930235170
Doc: <https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XtPln6wetTcl-KowzIC1AotqI9UFiUGnM68XpFQYZKU/edit?usp=sharing>
Summary:
- Limits Artisan purchases to non-combat skills, abilities, and spells from other classes at normal cost +5.
- Bars combat options, armor, shields, and weapons.
- Keeps six total levels, three per outside class, and current-rank restrictions.
- Includes a proposed class-by-class combat/non-combat classification.
answer-1: Yes
answer-2: No
answer-3: Abstain
name: No More Artisan, Only Non-Com Builds!
notes: Channel poll 2026-08-22: 12 of 20 votes (60%) supported a playtest. That was channel discussion context, not a Senate vote.
